content: India’s emerging agrivoltaics model enables farmers to grow crops beneath solar panels, offering a way to generate electricity while diversifying income. Vanita Bhatnagar speaks to farmers and agri-researchers to find out how high upfront costs, financing constraints, and uneven policy support are preventing more farmers from taking up projects beyond the pilots

title: Akhilesh’s ‘25 paise’ remark triggers row with RLD, Mayawati demands apology
content: RLD chief Jayant Chaudhary said, “If you had to use some cheap words in the political battle, you could have said it by taking my name. There was no issue…Targeting the Jat community and saying we taught them ABCD?”

content: Ms. Ratnakumari, who has over 30 years of teaching experience, is known for adopting innovative techniques to make teaching effective. She believes in engaging schoolchildren through activities on campus.

title: While Madras went to bed early, Chennai stays up
content: From closing up about 9 p.m. to queuing up for a plate of biriyani around 3 a.m., the city has come a long way; pubs emerged in the 1980s, and following an IT boom and a growing night-shift workforce in the late 90s, tea shops stayed open, eateries mushroomed, and sports facilities and gyms extended their hours, keeping the city alive at night

content: A radiant warmer machine in the Neonatal Intensive Care Unit caught fire due to sparks in its filament coil, causing injuries to three children; the three newborns were referred to the government medical college in Jabalpur where one of them died; the other two are stable, says District Collector

content: Green tribunal had held the Art of Living Foundation responsible for the damage to the Yamuna floodplains during its World Culture Festival in 2016; court says the area was already in a damaged state

title: Village students shifted to vacant house after attack on CJP activists in Rajasthan
content: About 20 students of the government primary school, who turned up for attending classes, were shifted to a vacant house situated nearby; the children were earlier studying in a cattle enclosure in unhygienic conditions; this was just a day after Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) activists were hounded out following their failed attempt to inspect the school

title: Naidu pitches Visakhapatnam as hub for BRICS sports network
content: Chief Minister invites investment in water sports and sports tourism, citing State’s long coastline and skilled youth

title: Gorkha issue: Union Government promises permanent solution; sets up committee
content: Gorkhas have been seeking a separate State of Gorkhaland comprising parts of Darjeeling hills and adjoining areas; Amit Shah assures the community of a political solution

content: Congress MP Pawan Khera, AAP’s Sanjay Singh, and RJD spokesperson Priyanka Bharti have extended support to Abhishek Upadhyay

title: ‘Who would apply medicine to child’s blisters?’: Delhi techie killed by in-laws; wife, 3 held
content: A software engineer died after an argument over household chores escalated. His wife and her brothers allegedly attacked and strangled him at his home. The victim's family members were also assaulted during the violent altercation. Police have arrested four individuals in connection with the software engineer's death. Investigations are ongoing into the matrimonial disputes which preceded the incident.

title: Gujarat store owner shot dead in US in front of 19-year-old daughter
content: A 56-year-old Gujarati man was fatally shot during a liquor store robbery. The gunman demanded cash and then fired multiple shots inside the premises. His 19-year-old daughter stood beside him but remained unharmed during the incident. Another employee suffered a fractured wrist after falling during the shooting. Police are actively searching for the unidentified suspect and his vehicle.

title: 'Masters in our own home': Canada PM Carney explains why talks with US were suspended
content: Canada has halted trade negotiations with the United States due to perceived inequities in demands, leading to the US imposing hefty tariffs on Canadian exports. In response, Canada has unveiled countermeasures to address these tariffs. Prime Minister Carney criticized the US for its unreasonable requests while providing insufficient concessions. This escalation raises alarms about the future of economic collaboration between the two nations.

title: Microsoft has a 6-word answer for students wondering if coding is still worth it
content: Microsoft Learn has told students on X that learning to code is worth it "now more than ever", even as AI writes a growing share of software. Satya Nadella says AI already produces up to 30% of Microsoft's code, while Google puts its figure at 75%. The skill has not died, it has shifted from writing syntax to reviewing, debugging and directing AI-generated code.

title: Portugal get their revenge on Spain — this time in cricket — after WC heartbreak
content: Portugal secured a cricket victory over Spain, avenging their football World Cup defeat.  The Portuguese team won the ICC Men's T20 World Cup Europe Sub Regional Qualifier C.  This triumph keeps Portugal's dream of reaching the 2028 T20 World Cup alive.  Spain's chase faltered after Portugal posted a competitive total of 160 runs.  Portugal's bowlers delivered a strong performance to secure the 57-run win.

title: Ganpati idol falls during procession in Mumbai; 2 dead, 5 injured
content: Two individuals died and five others sustained injuries when a large Ganpati idol collapsed during its procession. The idol fell due to an apparent welding issue with its supporting frame, police officials stated. The incident occurred late Saturday night as the procession neared its destination in Bhuleshwar. The deceased included the Ganpati mandal president, Sanket Nevshe. Investigations into the exact circumstances of the accident are currently underway by authorities.

title: Meta sued by former manager who claims he was fired over immigration letter
content: A former Meta manager filed a lawsuit alleging wrongful termination after objecting to an immigration letter. James Tillinghast claimed the letter overstated an employee's contributions and responsibilities. He also alleged Meta provided preferential immigration support to certain Chinese national employees. Tillinghast believes his dismissal was retaliation for raising these concerns. The lawsuit names Meta Platforms and a manager as defendants.

title: No work, no study, no training: 8.7 crore Indian youth caught in a career gap
content: With over eight crore Indian youth facing unemployment, a lack of vital skills hampers their job prospects. Financial barriers restrict many students from accessing crucial paid training programs, while graduates frequently settle for low-paying positions to assist their families financially. There is a stark career mismatch, as only a fraction of graduates find appropriate roles, making subsidized training and earn-as-you-learn opportunities essential for career advancement.

title: Engineer built Ozarks hillside home in 1970; son restores it 50 years later
content: A Missouri engineer spent years carving an underground home into an Ozarks hillside, building it largely by hand without an architect. Designed to resemble a natural cave, the property features steel-reinforced concrete, an earth-based ventilation system, heavy oak beams and railroad-inspired details. His son Zane now restores the remarkable 50-year-old home and surrounding 225-acre property.

title: Medical debt relief model: MacKenzie Scott’s gifts erase $40 billion; $10 cancels $1,000
content: MacKenzie Scott pioneered large-scale medical debt relief through significant donations. Her gifts enabled the abolition of over forty billion dollars in medical debt. This initiative has provided relief to millions of families across all fifty states. Scott's model has also inspired other billionaires to contribute to debt eradication efforts. While philanthropic efforts offer immediate relief, systemic reforms are needed for lasting change.

title: From tape-ball to 'dream of Harman’s wicket', Maryam follows her father’s dream
content: Hong Kong's vice-captain Maryam Bibi is gearing up for a pivotal challenge as she faces India. Her cricketing journey began with tape-ball games and has evolved into representing her nation on a larger stage. With aspirations to honor her father's dream, Bibi sees the match not only as a competitive opportunity but also as a source of inspiration for aspiring young female cricketers.

title: Govinda issues notice against defamatory content amid spat with wife Sunita Ahuja
content: Govinda, the celebrated actor, has taken a stand against false and defamatory content in a public notice. This alert focuses specifically on AI-generated images and misleading reports about his family. Emphasizing that no one has permission to manipulate his identity, he has threatened civil and criminal proceedings against those who violate these stipulations, aiming to combat the rampant spread of misinformation and rumors online.

title: Shoriful Islam makes history with record seven-wicket haul against Australia
content: Shoriful Islam achieved a historic seven-wicket haul against Australia in the second Test. His exceptional bowling figures of 7/48 marked a significant achievement for Bangladesh cricket. Australia secured a first-innings lead of 146 runs after being bowled out for 210. Earlier, Mitchell Starc's six-wicket haul had restricted Bangladesh to just 64 runs. Bangladesh face a challenging task to avoid defeat.

title: Travis Kelce reveals why he sought professional help after life changed overnight
content: Travis Kelce might be one of the most popula athletes in the world but he had to seek professional help which had changed his life overnight.

title: Patrick Mahomes reveals Brittany’s key role in transforming women’s sports
content: Patrick Mahomes has praised his wife Brittany Mahomes for helping transform women’s sports in Kansas City. As a founding co-owner of the Kansas City Current, Brittany helped turn her lifelong soccer passion into a larger movement, supporting investment in female athletes and the development of CPKC Stadium. Patrick called her a “driving force” behind the team’s rise, highlighting how her vision has created opportunities and inspired young girls across the city.

title: Tom Brady reveals heartbreaking moment Gisele Bündchen said she was unhappy
content: Years before their eventual divorce, Tom Brady openly discussed a difficult period in his marriage to Gisele Bündchen. In a 2020 interview with Howard Stern, Brady said Bündchen felt he was not doing enough for their family while he focused heavily on football and business. Her concerns forced him to reassess his priorities, and the couple sought counseling. Brady also revealed that he kept a heartfelt letter from Bündchen as a reminder.

title: U'khand disaster aid for damaged houses: Check eligibility, benefits & more
content: Uttarakhand disaster authority is stepping up to provide financial assistance for homes affected by recent calamities. The amount of aid is determined by the severity of the damage and the type of dwelling—pucca or kutcha houses receive different levels of support. Even huts and cattle sheds can qualify for aid, but relief funds will only be distributed after thorough verification by the officials.

title: Amid tensions with Hegseth, US Army secy Dan Driscoll to step down by year-end
content: US Army Secretary Dan Driscoll is reportedly planning to leave his position by late 2026.  This departure follows months of reported tension with Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth.  Driscoll's exit could leave the Army without a Senate-confirmed leader.  The Army also currently lacks a Senate-confirmed chief of staff.  These developments signal significant changes at the Pentagon's senior levels.

title: Ronaldo becomes first player in the Football history to achieve unprecedented feat
content: Cristiano Ronaldo has reached an incredible milestone in football by scoring in twenty-five consecutive league seasons. This unprecedented achievement highlights his enduring talent, having maintained an unbroken scoring streak that dates back to the 2002-03 season. With a career total of nine hundred seventy-seven goals, he remains focused on reaching the remarkable one thousand goal mark in his illustrious career.

title: 5.9 earthquake rattles Japan: 23 injured, trains disrupted; no tsunami threat
content: In the early hours of Sunday, eastern Japan experienced a moderate earthquake, with injuries reported for over twenty individuals, primarily minor. The strong tremors caused significant disruptions in transportation services, including train delays across the region. A water pipe burst was noted in Tokyo, alongside power outages affecting numerous homes. Fortunately, no tsunami threat emerged, and nuclear facilities remained secure.

title: Awarapan 2 Day 9: Emraan Hashmi film tops Rs 180cr worldwide despite Batwara 1947 clash
content: Awarapan 2 has taken the box office by storm, crossing the landmark of one hundred crore rupees. After a remarkable surge in earnings on its ninth day, the film's total net collection in India now stands at one hundred twenty-seven point five zero crore. Additionally, overseas collections have played a significant role in boosting its overall global revenue. This action-packed sequel follows the footsteps of the beloved 2007 movie Awarapan.

title: Kuldeep or Saransh? The subplot thickens as Colombo braces for a different script
content: Kuldeep Yadav's absence from India's final training sessions has intensified the selection intrigue ahead of the Colombo Test, with Saransh Jain's strong showing in the nets and Sri Lanka's left-hand-heavy batting line-up adding weight to the off-spinner's case. The second Test between India and Sri Lanka will start from Sunday at the Sinhalese Sports Club ground in Colombo.

title: Twist in double-murder suicide: Wife’s Rs 1.5 crore demand may have led to killings
content: A banker allegedly murdered his wife and sister in a double murder-suicide incident.  Divya Mishra sought a Rs 1.5 crore financial settlement in her divorce proceedings.  Strained relations over Manas Bajpayi's sister, Sheeba, also contributed to the marital discord.  Police are investigating the killings as a pre-planned sequence of events.  Digital evidence and witness statements are being analyzed to establish the motive.

title: Hockey World Cup: India's semifinal hopes end after 1-3 loss to Netherlands
content: The defeat leaves India without a point in the second round. India had already lost to England in the first round, and even a victory against Argentina on Monday would take them to only three points. That will not be enough to reach the semifinals. India will instead play in the fifth-eighth place classification matches after their final second-round game against Argentina.

title: FSSAI issued 150 notices to major food brands in recent months over misleading ads
content: India's food regulator FSSAI has issued over 150 notices to major food companies recently. These notices address misleading advertisements and non-compliance with labeling regulations. Action has been taken against brands like Nestle India and Coca-Cola India. E-commerce platforms Amazon and Flipkart also received multiple notices and a warehouse license cancellation. Food service establishments including KFC and McDonald's faced similar enforcement actions.

title: Being queer in Kashmir: Families, phones, friendships monitored, says report
content: A comprehensive report reveals the extensive control exerted over LGBTQIA+ individuals in Kashmir, highlighting issues such as monitored communications and scrutinized social interactions. The study emphasizes how family pressures and societal expectations surrounding marriage exacerbate marginalization. Additionally, educational institutions contribute to feelings of harassment and social exclusion. While some visibility fosters a degree of acceptance, it simultaneously increases the risk of backlash and surveillance for queer communities in the region.

title: Dhols, chants and belief: How Delhi turned a World Championships semi-final into a homecoming
content: A packed Indira Gandhi Indoor Stadium created an unforgettable atmosphere as Treesa Jolly and Gayatri Gopichand battled China's top seeds in the BWF World Championships semi-finals. Chants, dhols and unwavering support drove the Indian pair throughout their 64-minute contest. Though the eventual bronze medallists fell short, Delhi's passionate crowd emerged as one of the tournament's defining stories.

content: The US imposed 50% tariffs on about $20 billion worth of Canadian goods on Saturday, while Mark Carney said Ottawa would retaliate dollar for dollar beginning September 8.

content: The earthquake occurred in the southern Ibaraki prefecture, at a depth of 70 kilometres, an area of Japan prone to frequent quakes.

content: Of the nine persons killed in the hotel fire, seven were Bangladeshi residents, one was from Jharkhand and one from Siliguri in Darjeeling district of West Bengal.

content: Iran has asserted control of the Strait of Hormuz, through which around one fifth of the world's oil and LNG exports passed before the war.

title: India's Rocket Launches Costliest Among Major Space Powers: Cambridge Study
content: While the global average launch cost in 2025 stood at $3,868 per kilogram, the US averaged $3,225 per kilogram, Japan $5,287, China $5,809, Russia $6,682 and Europe $9,897. India topped the list at $13,302 per kilogram.

content: Rajnath Singh said non-communicable diseases such as diabetes, hypertension, heart disease, cancer, kidney failure and mental health disorders were increasingly becoming major health concerns.

content: Carney claimed that the US proposed new terms that were "uneconomic" and "unfair" and said that they undermined the net benefits for Canada.

title: Soon, no need for physical boarding cards at immigration
content: from sept 1, people flying in and out of india will no longer be required to provide a physical boarding card at the immigration counter . boarding passes will continue to be accepted at the Immi . the new measure will come into effect from sept 1 .

content: bar Council of India chairperson manan Kumar Mishra is facing a revolt from within the council itself . y R Sadasiva Reddy has sought his resignation, alleging financial irregularities during his tenure . the BJP MP termed the allegations a political stunt and vendetta .

title: 'Ties must serve mutual interest': EAM Jaishankar on Bangladesh

title: 'Conveyed our security concerns to US': Israel on Hamas disarmament plan
content: israel has conveyed 'serious security concerns' to the white house over the proposed disarmament deal with Hamas . a spokesperson for prime minister Benjamin Netanyahu’s office said the Israeli military would not withdraw from Gaza . the israeli military will not withdraw until israel lays down its weapons .

title: ‘Wrong-side’ driving trend: 12 deaths in Britain, Ireland linked to social media buzz
content: seven people, including two serving police officers, were killed after a car travelling in the wrong direction on the A66 near Middlesbrough in northeastern England collided head-on with a marked police vehicle . the deaths take the toll from the recent UK and Irish crashes to 12 .

title: Arizona eighth-grader’s drone study finds rural areas have more ground-level CO2
content: Luca McGill, 13, set out to measure carbon dioxide in the busiest city streets . his custom drone experiments revealed a completely different reality . by flying sensor equipment 120 meters into the air, he discovered that rural landscapes often contained higher ground-level carbon dioxide concentrations than nearby urban areas .

title: 'Vanished from tracking system': How Panama-flagged cargo ship sank off Odisha coast
content: MV Ocean Winner was carrying an iron ore cargo and had departed from Paradip Port . it was reportedly headed for Singapore, with an estimated arrival date of august 27 . the 225-metre-long ship was last reported more than 200 nautical miles off the Odisha coast before communication with it was lost .

title: Trump shares image calling Hormuz 'new US territory'; Iran says strait 'closed'
